spec_match.rationale: Probes and uses the real alphabet:'base64url' option; after the 2026-08-30 fix the page also states the true padding contract (padding kept unless omitPadding) and demonstrates omitPadding in the snippet.

interactive.rationale: Samples + free input drive both panels, problem-char highlighting, URL-encode comparison and the example URL.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises a side-by-side alphabet comparison; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: JWT-length input (padding kept, flagged with the omitPadding hint), binary-heavy input (real - and _ swaps), and the A+B/C= sample all verified live; fallback shim now matches native padding behavior.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite passes live; padding behavior is demonstrated in-page (an additive suite assertion for the padding contract would be a bonus — never editing the existing one).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chromium 141 headless via CDP/puppeteer 2026-08-30 (feature natively supported — shipped Chrome 140): every button/sample/control driven, DOM readouts verified after each action, console clean (only sandbox-blocked external font fetch), zero page overflow at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3, full-page screenshots read. Fix verified: JWT sample shows '1 "=" padding char(s) remain — pass { omitPadding: true }' with the '=' flagged red.

design_system.rationale: Variables used, but the problem/safe char marks put --text-black on --accent-rose/--accent-emerald backgrounds — rose #d11a2a behind black text is ~2.6:1, below AA for the small mono glyphs.

accessibility.rationale: Controls are labelled; highlighting is colour-only (mark elements carry no text alternative) and panels are not live regions.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Panels stack at 600px; zero overflow both classes.

openQuestions.detail: black-on-rose (~2.6:1) fails AA; use bg accent + ivory text per the design-system rule, and add e.g. an underline or aria-label so flagged chars are not colour-only.

openQuestions.title: Add an omitPadding toggle
openQuestions.detail: The snippet now documents omitPadding but the live panels always encode with padding; a checkbox exercising { omitPadding: true } would complete the contract demonstration.
